youtube.title: AI hackers are mashing up every game: Tony Hawk in GTA, CoD in Skyrim
youtube.description:
AI game mashups are the new mod scene: fans are rebuilding the crossovers studios never greenlit, and it takes a weekend instead of five years.

Tony Hawk's trick system dropped into GTA. Kingdom Hearts magic in a Borderlands map. Minecraft blocks in a photoreal forest. A Call of Duty killstreak called down over Skyrim.

The tell is the interface: each one keeps a single game's HUD and swaps the whole world around it, which is why they read as playable games instead of as clips.

Which two games would you mash together? Tell us in the comments.
